cases.name: Jaye’Mya E’shay Sudduth
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She graduated from Cedar Falls High school in 2022. Jaye'Mya earned her certification in phlebotomy and was currently a nursing student pursuing a career in nursing. With a passion for helping others, Jaye'Mya worked at Allen Clinic in the laboratory as a phlebotomist. In 2025, Jaye'Mya welcomed her greatest gift and accomplishment, her daughter, Torr'e."
